Subject: Re: Data retention & deletion SLAs — follow-up from this morning

Marissa — thanks for the summary, copying in a few technical clarifications so Amaya has concrete answers to the items above.

Neha (security) notes / clarifications: 
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for our hosted offering (we can share the latest PDF under an NDA). For Dedicated/Private deployments we provide SOC2 evidence as part of the onboarding package.
- Logical deletion vs backups: We perform immediate logical deletion of customer data upon a validated deletion request. Backups/snapshots are retained according to the configured backup retention window; by default backups are retained for 90 days. During that window, the deleted data may exist in encrypted backup objects.
- Backup encryption & KMS: Backups are encrypted at rest; for Private customers we can offer customer-managed KMS keys.
- Backup sanitization: We provide an option in contracts for a shorter backup purge SLA (e.g., 30/60/90 days) depending on the customer tier — but physical removal from storage for all snapshots is bounded by our backup retention + storage lifecycle processes (typical propagation is up to 90 days).
- Logs & audit trails: Application-level logs and audit logs are retained by default for 180 days. We can extend retention up to 2 years for an add-on. Note: audit logs are retained separately from customer content and can be exported on request.
- Restoration risk: If a deletion request is submitted, we prevent future restores that would reintroduce deleted data; however, there is a short window while backups containing the deleted objects age out. Our recommended contractual language is: logical deletion within 24 hours, and backups purged within 90 days unless an accelerated purge is contracted.

If Amaya has specific HIPAA/GDPR obligations (e.g., data subject requests requiring sub-30-day physical purge), please flag and we can scope accelerated remediation and an SLA.

Happy to jump on a quick call with Amaya's security/engineering team to walk through retention, encryption, and KMS options.

-Neha

Thanks Marissa and Neha — attaching our vendor security questionnaire for Redwood to fill (attached: Amaya_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). A few items to call out from our side so your answers map to our procurement requirements: 

Amaya baseline asks (high level):
- Deletion SLA for customer data including propagation to backups: required <= 60 days (we prefer 30 days for PHI under HIPAA).
- Log retention: security logs/audit trails must be retained for at least 12 months; certain audit trails for regulated customers may need 24 months.
- SOC 2 Type II: Required for hosted vendors; copy of report or SOC 2 letter and control matrix preferred.
- Encryption & keys: clarify if you offer CMEK (customer-managed encryption keys) or only provider-managed keys.
- Backup lifecycle: are backups snapshots immutable? Are older snapshots overwritten or deleted after retention period?

Please fill the attached questionnaire and return it to legal@amayahealth.com and me by Aug 4 so our procurement/security team can move forward. If Redwood can confirm an option for a 30-day backup purge for HIPAA customers (with pricing), that would speed our internal approvals.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Samira

Subject: Re: Data retention & deletion SLAs — follow-up and answers / next steps

Samira — thanks for the questionnaire and the clear timeline. We've reviewed internally and can provide the following as a baseline; we'll also populate your questionnaire and return it by your Aug 4 target.

Redwood baseline answers (summary):
- SOC 2: We can share the Redwood SOC 2 Type II attestation (Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf) under NDA. Link: https://docsend.com/view/redwood-soc2-2026.
- Deletion SLA (customer data): logical deletion within 24 hours of a validated request. Backups: default retention 90 days; we offer contractable accelerated purge options (30/60/90 days) for HIPAA customers for an add-on. Physical removal from backups is subject to snapshot lifecycle but we guarantee purge within the contracted window.
- Backups & encryption: backups are encrypted at rest. For Private deployments we support customer-managed keys (CMEK).
- Logs & audit trails: default 180 days; can be extended to 12 or 24 months per contract. We can provide exports of audit logs on request to support compliance reviews.
- Restoration behavior: once a deletion is validated we block restores that would reintroduce deleted content; restored objects created after the deletion will not contain the removed records.

Next steps:
1) Neha will fill the technical sections of your attached questionnaire and return it with the SOC2 letter by Aug 3.
2) If Amaya needs a formally contractable 30-day backup purge for HIPAA-covered data, we can scope the pricing and include the clause in the Data Processing Addendum (DPA). Please confirm whether you need this by Aug 4.
3) Optional: a 30-minute technical call (Neha + Amaya security) — propose Tues Aug 6 at 10:00 AM PT.

I'll attach the SOC2 letter in our return and populate your spreadsheet. Let me know which date/time works for the call.

Best,
